anha-mcp — bridge a stdio MCP client to ANHA

USAGE
  anha-mcp [--url <endpoint>]     Run the bridge (default; what a client launches)
  anha-mcp login [--url <e>]      Authorize now, in a browser
  anha-mcp logout [--url <e>]     Forget the stored authorization
  anha-mcp --help

OPTIONS
  --url <endpoint>   MCP endpoint (default https://resolver.anha.ai/mcp, or $ANHA_MCP_URL)

ENVIRONMENT
  ANHA_MCP_URL       Same as --url
  ANHA_CLIENT_ID     Skip dynamic registration and use this client_id

Tokens are cached at /tmp/.anha/mcp-tokens.json (mode 0600).
